title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Owned-Property Account Factor at Renewal
content:
Owned-property account factor for a renewal, **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs**, residential renewal schedule (Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier): the program renewal rate per 100 is multiplied by 0.92 when the premium payments the lender made in the last 12 months on its own NFIP Dwelling Form policies with Tidemark total 10000 dollars or more and the program has been in force 24 months or more; by 0.96 when those payments total 3000 dollars or more and the program has been in force 12 months or more, but the payments are below 10000 dollars or the program has been in force fewer than 24 months; and by 1.00 in every other case.

The payments read are the payment entries received on the policies the lender holds as insured under the **NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)**, each dated by the day received. Months in force for a renewal are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached; a renewal window of the last 12 months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than 12 such whole months have passed by today.

**Decision grid**

| | In force 24 months or more | In force 12 to 23 months | In force fewer than 12 months |
|---|---|---|---|
| Payments of 10000 dollars or more | 0.92 | 0.96 | 1.00 |
| Payments of 3000 to below 10000 dollars | 0.96 | 0.96 | 1.00 |
| Payments below 3000 dollars | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
